messages.content: Independent enterprise release-risk reviewer for exact SHA 662c5dbde18df3fa3637d317a3e399429510a856. P means PASS and F means FAIL. Return F only for a concrete unresolved material defect. External Google OAuth client creation is a separately gated setup step, not a code defect when product stays unavailable until configured. Output schema JSON only.

V10 departmental access exact candidate. It preserves existing tenant/RBAC and Graph execution. Roles remain simple: owner/Propietario, reviewer/Coordinador municipal for content/CRITIC, admin/IT for independent verification/final release and non-owner team administration. Google authentication is invitation-only; Media Factory remains authoritative for tenant membership and role. OAuth is confidential code flow with PKCE S256, server one-time state, OIDC nonce, browser-flow HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie binding, token exchange at Google token endpoint, RS256/JWKS verification, iss/aud/azp/exp/iat/nonce/email_verified checks, authoritative Gmail/Workspace email and durable Google sub. No Google access/refresh token is stored. Google Client Secret is AES-256-GCM encrypted in persistent private product storage, never returned by APIs, and corrupted ciphertext fails closed. Local password stays as break-glass.

Release-edge finding resolved in this exact candidate: an earlier deployment of the predecessor candidate showed the host forward-auth correctly returned 401 for the anonymous /api/v1/auth/google/config API. The login page had depended on that call, so Google could never appear through the protected edge. This candidate removes that anonymous API dependency. The public /login server component reads Google availability internally from the trusted server service and passes only a boolean to the client component. The Google config API remains private at the edge. Thus no auth API was newly opened and the login can show Google after secure owner configuration on the production HTTPS origin. Browser E2E now asserts the login does not make an anonymous Google-config client call.

Exact validation on this SHA: full suite 211 discovered / 210 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 pre-existing SKIP; targeted departmental auth/team/review/scene/services/host/metadata 57/57 PASS; TypeScript PASS; production build PASS; contracts 13/13 PASS; production audit no known vulnerabilities; exact clean browser E2E PASS with runtime 1481 files, zero forbidden entries, zero external symlinks, runtime manifest 032c9b75bbbd1a48bc13f2dd06066da99f7d19650b4c54faf64077134bfba097, production source 15ec4e127c454736578b612779e02704f8aae99360d76870577448dd7fce5816; exact clean non-test FIRMES completion PASS with 1080x1920 8-second artifact. A real Google OAuth client has not been supplied and no live Google account smoke is claimed. Production remains Google-unavailable until the owner configures a Web OAuth client and registers the exact callback URI. No paid provider smoke is part of this scope.
